# Mathematics Grade 10 — Day 1 (Revised)

## Learning Objectives

- Understand and apply quadratic equations
- Connect to real-world applications

## Activities

1. Warm-up: real-world quadratic puzzle (5 min)
2. Direct instruction (15 min)
3. Worked examples with student input (15 min)
4. Partner practice (15 min)

## Assessment

Formative: whiteboard responses. Exit ticket: one real-world quadratic problem.
